children: On September 1, 2026, REDWOOD CAPITAL BANCORP (OTCQX: RWCB), the only locally owned and operated community bank holding company in Humboldt County, California, announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Redwood Capital Bank, plans to open a non-branch Loan Production Office (LPO) in Redding, California, and has hired Jamie Robertson as Commercial Relationship Manager.

The planned Redding LPO represents Redwood Capital Bank’s continued commitment to strategic growth and will expand the bank’s commercial lending presence in Redding and throughout Shasta County. The LPO will focus on building relationships with local businesses and providing the personalized and relationship-based approach that have been hallmarks of Redwood Capital Bank for more than two decades.

Jennifer P. Budwig, President, remarked, “We are excited to expand Redwood Capital Bank’s presence into the Redding market and especially pleased to welcome Jamie Robertson to our team. Jamie is a well-established commercial banking professional who understands the businesses and people of the Redding community. Her experience, relationships and commitment to exceptional customer service make her an ideal fit for Redwood Capital Bank as we thoughtfully expand our commercial lending services into a new Northern California market.”

Ms. Robertson added, “I am thrilled to join Redwood Capital Bank and introduce its relationship-focused approach to commercial lending to the Redding community. I have spent many years building relationships with local businesses throughout the Redding area and look forward to continuing to serve them with the personalized attention, responsiveness and community-minded decision making that set Redwood Capital Bank apart from other financial institutions.”
